description: This file contains firmware functions for miscellaneous system configurations on STM32F10x microcontrollers, including NVIC priority grouping, interrupt initialization, vector table setup, low power mode configuration, and SysTick clock source configuration.

methods.name: NVIC_PriorityGroupConfig
methods.description: Configures the priority grouping for interrupts, setting pre-emption and subpriority bits.

methods.name: NVIC_Init
methods.description: Initializes NVIC peripheral with specified interrupt channel and priority settings.

methods.name: NVIC_SetVectorTable
methods.description: Sets the location and offset of the vector table in memory.

methods.name: SysTick_CLKSourceConfig
methods.description: Configures the clock source for the SysTick timer.
